stories.title: North Wales Coast line to close through Flint and Shotton for three weeks in January
stories.summary: Trains through Flint and Shotton Low Level will stop for three weeks in January while Network Rail carries out more than £25 million of work on the North Wales Coast line. stories.title: North Wales health board says two-year waiting lists ‘almost zero’ by next April
stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board says by April 2027 there will be almost no patients waiting two years or more for treatment in North Wales. stories.title: Council tax rises a matter for councils, says First Minister
stories.summary: Decisions on council tax rises should stay with local councils, the First Minister has said, as Flintshire County Council faces a budget gap of up to £22 million next year. stories.title: Fine for leaving engine running while parked rises to up to £150 in Wales
stories.summary: Drivers in Wales who leave their engines running while parked face fines of up to £150 from today, up from £20. stories.title: Airbus A350F freighter with Broughton-built wings makes first flight
stories.summary: A new Airbus cargo plane with wings built at Broughton has made its first flight. The first A350F freighter test aircraft took off from Toulouse on Tuesday 29 September and flew for four hours and 10 minutes, reaching 25,000 feet and a speed of 340 knots.
